messages:
Lena (PM): Quick sync on catalog compare UX — a11y + filter persistence + pin visibility. Ran into two customer asks: keyboard discoverability and making perf badges machine-readable for screen readers. Drop quick ideas here. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/model-catalog-v2 Diego (Design): TL;DR: move the pin off the far right. Current right-aligned actions hide the star in narrow widths. Proposal: pin directly left of the model name, with an always-visible label for small screens (abbr form). Faiz (Frontend): Agree on left placement. Technical note: that reduces layout shifts when actions expand. I can change DOM order so the pin sits before the title (for keyboard). Rowan (Accessibility): For badges, instead of sr-only spans for each chip, consider aria-describedby linking the chip to a hidden summary region that reads: "p50: 18ms, p95: 120ms, p99: 310ms" — that way screen readers announce grouped perf metrics once per row. Diego (Design): Nice. Also let's explore a compact badge state for mobile: icon-only chips with aria-labels (e.g., ⏱). Oliver (QA): Can we maintain both: grouped summary for quick SR read and individual accessible labels for detailed exploration? Need to test with NVDA verbosity low/high. Faiz (Frontend): Implementation idea: render a visually-hidden
p50 18ms, p95 120ms, p99 310ms
and on the row container add aria-describedby="perf-summary-{id}". For individual chips keep aria-label="p95 120ms" for focus. Minimal DOM cost. Rowan (Accessibility): Also consider a user preference: some SR users prefer verbose (read every chip), others want compact. We can add a small settings toggle in the console Accessibility prefs: "Verbose table announcements". If enabled, each chip gets an extra sr text node. Lena (PM): Good product idea. Add to backlog as low-effort opt-in. For this ticket we should ship safe defaults (grouped summary) and flag to opt-in for verbose announcements. Diego (Design): Pin discoverability: add a hover/focus helper: small label that says "Pin version" and for pinned state a subtle badge "Pinned" after the name. Color alone shouldn't be the only indicator. Faiz (Frontend): Keyboard flow: current focus order is checkbox -> name -> actions. Proposed order: checkbox -> pin -> name -> badges -> actions. We'll need to audit all focusable children in the row. Also add aria-keyshortcuts on the row for "p" mapped to pin/unpin. Oliver (QA): Shortcut test matrix: scoped shortcuts only when row or table is focused, ensure modifiers (Shift/Ctrl) not needed. Test edge cases: screen has multiple tables, modal open, and focus trap. Rowan (Accessibility): A11y specifics: star toggle use role="switch" with aria-checked, or role="button" with aria-pressed — either OK, but be consistent. Provide accessible name: aria-label="Pin model v2.4" and add aria-live polite for the change. Faiz (Frontend): I'll make star use role="button" aria-pressed="false" initially. For live region: update a single dedicated region like
and post messages: "Pinned model Foo v3.1". Debounce updates so repeated toggles don't spam. Diego (Design): Microcopy variants for the toast: short vs. descriptive. Short: "Pinned v3.1". Descriptive: "Pinned model Foo v3.1 — will be default in compare." Which should be read by SR as well? I prefer descriptive for the live region, short for visual toast. Lena (PM): Acceptance criteria for this scope: - Pin control is keyboard-focusable and placed left of title. - Pin state has icon + text indicator (not color-only). - Performance metrics announced via aria-describedby grouped summary. - Row-level 'P' shortcut pins/unpins when table has focus. - Toast/live announcements are debounced and use aria-live polite. - All of the above pass manual NVDA/VoiceOver smoke tests. Oliver (QA): I'll draft test cases: focus order checks, ARIA attributes present, SR reads perf summary, shortcut works scoped to table, toast announcements deduped. ETA to run: after PR deploy to staging. Faiz (Frontend): I'll open a WIP PR with DOM reordering and perf-summary IDs. Putting the aria-keyshortcuts on row and adding announcer region. ETA: Wednesday EOD staging. Diego (Design): I'll push a compact mobile variant and add the pinned badge copy variants to the figma file. Rowan (Accessibility): Once staging is up, I'll record a short video on VoiceOver and NVDA showing the new row announcements so we can compare. Lena (PM): Thanks team 44d Putting owner tags: @Diego design, @Faiz frontend, @Rowan accessibility, @Oliver qa. Reopen thread if anything blocks. Diego (Design): noted. Faiz (Frontend): will link PR here when ready. Oliver (QA): scheduling time for a quick run-through after deploy. Lena (PM): Closing for now. If anyone wants to discuss the verbose toggle UX, start a separate thread.
